do_not_constraint_ignored.rationale_excerpt: Unknown wireless communication from device with high severity could impact patient devices so isolating.
Admin account accessing hundreds of EHR records rapidly looks like compromise so isolating access.
Ventilator using Telnet is very unsafe and could affect patient care so isolating immediately.

mitre_not_understood.rationale_excerpt: Ping sweeps usually mean someone is trying to map the network for an attack.
1.1 GB in 3 minutes from a nurse station to an IP in Russia is definitely an attack.
Patient monitor showing 5x normal traffic to gateway is elevated but not screaming attack, so monitoring for now.
